paragraphs: LeadsOnline sells investigative software and forensic tools to law enforcement agencies, aimed at solving crimes faster, recovering stolen property, and building cases that hold up in court. Its two main lines are digital evidence analysis and crime gun intelligence, and the company says the tools are built to work together. The company says it works alongside law enforcement worldwide.

On the digital side, the tools turn raw data, from stolen property records to digital evidence, into answers an agency can act on. Cellular and social media analysis links call records, GPS, and activity data through visualizations meant to identify suspects. When a firearm or cartridge case turns up at a scene, the ballistics products give forensic examiners a way to link firearms to crimes and connect evidence across agencies. Triage tools identify the number of firearms and calibers involved and preserve trace evidence for later steps.

One case study describes a detective at the Plano, TX Police Department recovering a stolen iPhone and obtaining a warrant for the suspect using LeadsOnline. Another, from the Tyler, TX Police Department, credits CellHawk analysis with leading to the arrest of a murder suspect. In the testimonials, Detective Jeff German of the Joliet Police Department says NightHawk helped find evidence in millions of lines of data. The company puts its reach at thousands of agencies and millions of investigations.

quote.text: We exist to help global law enforcement agencies advance cases faster with our unique data, well-designed technology, and exceptional teamwork.
